name: Autoposting MCP
description: MCP tools for social drafts, AI content, carousels, video clips, scheduling and publishing. Hosted Streamable HTTP uses OAuth 2.1 and workspace consent. The MIT TypeScript CLI (@autoposting.ai/cli 0.4.0) offers stdio via ap mcp with AUTOPOSTING_API_KEY and Node >=20. Requires paid Autoposting access; publishing requires connected social accounts. Backend is proprietary, not self-hostable; render jobs are asynchronous.
